title: Swimlane gallery
text: geom_swimlane() draws one bar per subject. order_swimlane() relevels subject column first lanes run shortest longest, theme_swimlane() supplies finished look:  Add fill variable color lanes cohort; pass variable order_swimlane() group lanes:
code: patient_disposition |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study) +   labs(x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane() patient_disposition |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) +   labs(x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane()

title: Swimlane gallery
text: Three layers mark events along lane, generates legend entry automatically: geom_swimlane_status() marks end lane subject’s status; subjects still study (NA status) get rightward arrow. geom_swimlane_marker() marks -lane events responses. geom_swimlane_rug() flags baseline characteristics left margin.
code: patient_disposition |>   mutate(     prior_drug = if_else(prior_drug == "Yes", "Prior therapy", NA)   ) |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) +   geom_swimlane_status(subject, weeks_on_study, reason_off_study) +   geom_swimlane_marker(     subject, partial_response,     marker_label = "Partial response"   ) +   geom_swimlane_rug(subject, prior_drug) +   labs(title = "Time on study by subject", x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane()

title: Swimlane gallery
text: one row per subject phase, bar segments stack factor-level order. lane splits treatment follow-phases; note order_swimlane() runs pivoting lanes stay ordered total duration:
code: patient_disposition |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   mutate(     Treatment = weeks_on_treatment,     `Follow-up` = weeks_on_study - weeks_on_treatment   ) |>   tidyr::pivot_longer(     c(Treatment, `Follow-up`),     names_to = "phase", values_to = "weeks"   ) |>   mutate(phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Treatment", "Follow-up"))) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks, phase) +   geom_swimlane_status(subject, weeks_on_study, reason_off_study) +   labs(title = "Treatment and follow-up phases", x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane()

title: Swimlane gallery
text: Prefer text symbols? geom_swimlane_label() writes status past end bar. Widen right margin make room:
code: patient_disposition |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) +   geom_swimlane_label(subject, weeks_on_study, reason_off_study) +   labs(x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane(extra_margin_r = 60)

title: Swimlane gallery
text: built-scales step aside discrete scale add (ggplot2 prints message scale replaced). Theme settings pass theme_swimlane(), including inside legend:
code: patient_disposition |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) +   scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +   labs(x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane(     base_size = 12,     legend.position = "inside",     legend.position.inside = c(0.9, 0.15)   )

what: Create Clinical Trial Swimlanes with ggplot
title: Create Clinical Trial Swimlanes with ggplot
text: ggswimlane ggplot2 extension swimlane (swimmer) plots, common way show patient trajectories clinical trial: one bar per subject, events, status, baseline characteristics marked along lane. Legends come free, default palette theme ready reports without styling.

title: Create Clinical Trial Swimlanes with ggplot
text: can install development version ggswimlane GitHub :
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("tgerke/ggswimlane")

title: Create Clinical Trial Swimlanes with ggplot
text: complete swimlane bundled patient_disposition data. geom_swimlane_*() layer takes bare column names, every symbol added legend automatically:  gallery vignette walks simpler starting points, stacked treatment phases, text annotations, customization.
code: library(dplyr) library(ggplot2) library(ggswimlane)  patient_disposition |>   mutate(     prior_drug = if_else(prior_drug == "Yes", "Prior therapy", NA)   ) |>   order_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) |>   ggplot() +   geom_swimlane(subject, weeks_on_study, cohort) +   geom_swimlane_status(subject, weeks_on_study, reason_off_study) +   geom_swimlane_marker(     subject, partial_response,     marker_label = "Partial response"   ) +   geom_swimlane_rug(subject, prior_drug) +   labs(title = "Time on study by subject", x = "Weeks on study") +   theme_swimlane()

title: Swimlane bars — geom_swimlane
text: core layer swimlane plot: one horizontal bar per subject, subjects y-axis duration x-axis. Optionally filled grouping variable, either one row per subject (e.g. cohort) several rows per subject stacked segments (e.g. treatment phases).

title: Swimlane bars — geom_swimlane
code: geom_swimlane(   id_var,   duration_var,   fill_var = NULL,   width = 0.6,   position = ggplot2::position_stack(reverse = TRUE),   ... )

title: Swimlane bars — geom_swimlane
text: id_var Column subject identifier, mapped y-axis. Use order_swimlane() first control lane order. duration_var Numeric column bar length, mapped x-axis. fill_var Optional column mapped bar fill. one row per subject colors whole lanes (e.g. cohort); multiple rows per subject segments stack (e.g. treatment phases). width Bar width. position Position adjustment. default stacks segments factor-level order, first level fill_var starts zero. ... arguments passed ggplot2::geom_col().

Adding fill shape scale replaces built-one; ggplot2 print standard message happens.

title: ggswimlane 0.1.0
text: release modernizes package throughout. breaking release: plots built 0.0.0.9000 need updates.

title: ggswimlane 0.1.0
text: geom_swimlane_status() marks end--lane status (e.g. reason study) shaped points automatic legend, replacing text annotations recommended default; subjects still study drawn rightward arrow legend entry (#2, #3). geom_swimlane_marker() marks -lane events responses, optional entry shared shape legend. geom_swimlane_rug() now draws shape-mapped points legend entry, documented honestly start--lane marker left margin (#1, #2). geom_swimlane() gains stacked-segment support: pass long data fill_var treatment phase segments stack factor-level order (#4). new weeks_on_treatment column patient_disposition gallery vignette demonstrate . Plots now look polished without additional scales: geom_swimlane() applies built-colorblind-safe fill shape scales (Okabe-Ito colors; scale_fill_swimlane(), scale_colour_swimlane(), scale_shape_swimlane() also exported), theme_swimlane() redesigned bottom legend default. user-facing functions validate column arguments error informatively.

title: ggswimlane 0.1.0
text: ggplot2 >= 3.5.0 R >= 4.1 now required. geom_swimlane() maps subjects y-axis natively instead using coord_flip(); cohort_var renamed fill_var. order_swimlane() now relevels column passed id_var rather always writing result column named subject. geom_swimlane_text() removed; use geom_swimlane_status() text alternative geom_swimlane_label(), passes ... layer rather treating aesthetics. magrittr pipe re-export removed; use native pipe |>. ggtext lubridate dependencies dropped.
